content.value_statement: Healthcare and MedTech teams need structured ISO 27001 security programs that connect risk, controls, incidents, and audits. This skill guides ISMS planning, risk assessment, control selection, and certification readiness using ISO 27001 and ISO 27002.
actual_capabilities: Outline ISO 27001:2022 ISMS scope, policies, objectives, and management review activities.
Guide security risk assessment with asset classification, threat analysis, risk evaluation, and treatment planning.
Map ISO 27002:2022 controls across organizational, people, physical, and technological domains.
Address healthcare requirements, including HIPAA safeguards, FDA cybersecurity guidance, and medical device security.
Structure incident management workflows from detection through post-incident improvement.
Prepare certification readiness, internal audit planning, and surveillance audit activities.
limitations: Does not perform automated vulnerability scanning or penetration testing by itself.
Does not replace a certified ISO 27001 auditor or legal counsel.
Includes placeholder support files, so generated templates require user validation.
Requires accurate organizational scope, asset inventories, and regulatory context from the user.

use_cases.title: Plan an ISMS rollout
use_cases.description: Create a phased ISO 27001 implementation plan with scope, policies, risk activities, controls, and management review checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Assess device security controls
use_cases.description: Review medical device cybersecurity needs and connect them to risk treatment, access control, monitoring, and update management.

use_cases.title: Prepare audit evidence
use_cases.description: Organize internal audit scope, control evidence, compliance status, and readiness gaps before certification or surveillance audits.

prompt_templates.title: Create an ISMS Scope
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define an ISO 27001 ISMS scope for a HealthTech company. Include boundaries, assets, stakeholders, regulations, and assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Risk Assessment Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an information security risk assessment plan for these systems and data types. Include asset classification, threats, impact, likelihood, and treatment options.

prompt_templates.title: Map ISO 27002 Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Map ISO 27002:2022 controls to our stated risks. Group controls by organizational, people, physical, and technological domains.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Audit Readiness Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our ISO 27001 readiness for certification. Identify evidence gaps, responsible owners, management review needs, and remediation priorities.

output_examples.input: Define an ISMS scope for a cloud-based patient engagement platform.
output: Scope boundaries covering product hosting, support operations, patient data flows, and supplier dependencies.
Key assets such as production systems, clinical data, identity services, logs, and customer support tools.
Assumptions and exclusions that should be confirmed before audit planning.

output_examples.input: Map top risks to ISO 27002 controls for a connected medical device.
output: Risk treatment themes for authentication, secure updates, event logging, segmentation, and vulnerability handling.
Suggested ISO 27002 control groups with owners and evidence examples.
Open questions for device architecture, clinical workflow, and supplier responsibilities.

output_examples.input: Prepare a management review agenda for ISO 27001.
output_examples.output: A concise agenda covering risk changes, control performance, incidents, audit results, corrective actions, resource needs, and improvement decisions.

best_practices: Provide scope, locations, systems, data types, and regulatory obligations before requesting an ISMS plan.
Review every generated control, policy, and risk rating with accountable business owners.
Keep evidence names, owners, dates, and review status aligned with certification audit expectations.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generic control lists as proof of ISO 27001 compliance.
Do not share patient data, credentials, or production incident details in prompts.
Do not use the skill to plan unauthorized testing or reconnaissance.

faq.question: Can this skill certify my organization?
faq.answer: No. It can help prepare materials, but certification requires an accredited certification body and formal audit process.

faq.question: Does it support ISO 27001:2022?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill content references ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 27002:2022 control categories.

faq.question: Can it help with healthcare security requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers HIPAA safeguards, medical device cybersecurity, clinical data protection, and healthcare interoperability security.

faq.question: Does it run security scans?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning and governance guidance, but it does not perform automated vulnerability scanning.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What inputs improve results?
faq.answer: Provide business scope, asset inventories, data types, suppliers, regulations, existing controls, incidents, and audit goals.
